GROW.content:
# Research

Verified two independent primary sources on pricing and onboarding.

FRAME.content:
# Research Brief

## Finding 1
Enterprise buyers prefer usage-based pricing over flat annual tiers when evaluating renewal contracts, confirmed at https://example.com/verified/pricing-report.

## Finding 2
Mid-market churn drops meaningfully when onboarding includes a live product demo within the first week, confirmed at https://example.com/verified/onboarding-study.

## Contradiction addressed
Early interviews suggested flat-tier preference among enterprise buyers before the verified pricing report (https://example.com/verified/pricing-report) was reviewed and superseded that signal.
FRAME.summary: Synthesized both verified findings into the final report and cited both sources.
